prerequisite_gate.interpretation: Held-out partnership results are descriptive only; sender, receiver and pair-specific compatibility cannot be adjudicated until every independently trained skill qualifies.

scientific_boundary: This is a bounded 8-bit mechanism probe. It does not establish broad reasoning, lifelong learning, forward transfer, scalability, or architectural superiority. Independent new seeds, larger state spaces and longer chains remain required.
selection_boundary: All lambda and policy selections used development partnerships only. Held-out test partnerships were not used for selection.
